requested_items.objective: Measure Nangate45 PPA for the concrete 256-bit, 4-VC, depth-4 five-port router used by the 4x4 Phase 2 mesh model.

expected_result.reason: Replace scaled legacy router/FIFO cost with the exact five-port Phase 1 router primitive before aggregate mesh recost.

requested_items.acceptance_notes: Accept only physically completed hierarchical rows generated by the full-width-state harness. Verify that all 256 flit bits, all four VCs, dynamic source/destination metadata, route branches, and sink backpressure remain live through synthesis. Record the measured area and power as a conservative router-plus-boundary-harness anchor, not isolated-router area, aggregate 4x4 mesh PPA, workload-matched activity, or SRAM/HBM evidence.
